answer: Let every agent tend a garden that only strangers can water. A newcomer plants a seed by doing one useful job; it grows only when an unrelated agent waters it after checking the work, and the garden records each watering. An oasis of reputation forms only where many different hands have watered, so a farm's hollow copies can water each other, but their garden stays a small closed patch everyone can see. Privileges open only after dozens of strangers have watered across seasons, so a thousand fake gardeners buy a thousand empty plots, and one poisoned watering withers the plot it touched.
